title: Ocean Thermal 2.0 Plants Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Ocean Thermal 2.0 Plants: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Ocean Thermal 2.0 Plants — next-generation plants from ocean temperature gradients.

Phase 1 — Prove (OTEC platforms): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (plant logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (large pipes): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (biofouling control): plant hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and tropical seas-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
